Estimate sunrise and sunset times

Source: R/sun_times.R
sun_times.Rd

Estimate sunrise and sunset times for a location and date. This is a stripped down version of getSunlightTimes from the suncalc package, which implements the SunCalc algorithm by Vladimir Agafonkin (https://github.com/mourner/suncalc).

Usage

sun_times(date, lat, long, tz = "UTC")

Arguments

date

Date vector, or a vector that can be converted with as.Date

lat

numeric for latitude

long

numeric for longitude (negative west of prime meridian)

tz

chr string for timezone of the output, e.g., 'America/Chicago'

Value

A data.frame with columns date, sunrise, and sunset. The latter two are POSIXct in the timezone given by tz. Values are NA if the sun does not rise or set on a date, e.g., polar day or night.

Details

Times are estimated for a solar altitude of -0.833 degrees, which accounts for atmospheric refraction and the radius of the solar disc. Estimates are typically within one to two minutes of those from the NOAA solar calculator for mid-latitude locations. Times for each date are based on the solar transit nearest to noon UTC on that date.

This function is used within metab_day to identify metabolic days for ecometab.

See also

metab_day

Examples

# Apalachicola Bay NERR, Florida
sun_times(as.Date('2024-06-21'), lat = 29.67, long = -85.06, tz = 'America/Jamaica')
#>         date             sunrise              sunset
#> 1 2024-06-21 2024-06-21 05:41:52 2024-06-21 19:44:54

# a sequence of dates
dts <- seq(as.Date('2024-01-01'), as.Date('2024-01-07'), by = 'days')
sun_times(dts, lat = 29.67, long = -85.06, tz = 'America/Jamaica')
#>         date             sunrise              sunset
#> 1 2024-01-01 2024-01-01 07:36:30 2024-01-01 17:52:56
#> 2 2024-01-02 2024-01-02 07:36:44 2024-01-02 17:53:38
#> 3 2024-01-03 2024-01-03 07:36:57 2024-01-03 17:54:20
#> 4 2024-01-04 2024-01-04 07:37:08 2024-01-04 17:55:03
#> 5 2024-01-05 2024-01-05 07:37:17 2024-01-05 17:55:47
#> 6 2024-01-06 2024-01-06 07:37:25 2024-01-06 17:56:31
#> 7 2024-01-07 2024-01-07 07:37:31 2024-01-07 17:57:17
